name: Pilgrimage Church of Wies
description: The Wieskirche stands in a quiet meadow in the Alpine foothills near Steingaden in Bavaria. From outside it looks like a plain white country church, but the oval interior, built between 1745 and 1754 by the brothers Dominikus and Johann Baptist Zimmermann, bursts with pastel stucco, gilding and a ceiling fresco of heaven opening overhead. It remains a working pilgrimage church.
